urls.rationale: Ch. 112 (Public Officers and Employees: General Provisions) contains Part III (Code of Ethics), which houses the executive-branch lobbying registration and reporting statute (F.S. 112.3215 et seq.).

notes: Title X exposes Ch.110-122. Only Ch.112 contains the lobbying-disclosure regime (Part III Code of Ethics); other chapters (employment, retirement, notaries, public records, administrative procedure) are out of regime.
